recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-43224; only revisit the human-readable invariant text if the work group wants an editorial clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-43224 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I change request saying sdf-5 was too strict because it required context on reprofiled extensions. The accepted resolution was to add a base check so profiles based on an existing extension inherit that extension's context instead of restating it.
initial_application: Commit 7d44c866fdb8481d1f6efe9ca2f33f969cd99466 applied FHIR-43224 by adding a base guard to sdf-5 in source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml. Commit ec757b779e600c414583fa08c927deea20812f51 later corrected the property name from base to baseDefinition, matching the current StructureDefinition element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes structuredefinition=StructureDefinition and assigns StructureDefinition the sdf status code, so the inspected XML is in current build scope. The linked Zulip thread records the original reprofiling-extension failure and the reporter's FHIR-43224 filing. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-04-22 record the 8-0-0 motion to approve adding the base guard, and Jira/community searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current sdf-5 is type != 'Extension' or baseDefinition != 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Extension' or derivation = 'specialization' or (context.exists()), which implements the approved behavior while still requiring context for newly defined extensions.
